Hamza Abdelkarim and Ebrima Tunkara START. #fcblive

🎥 | 𝐆𝐎𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐋𝐋. Ebrima Tunkara opens the scoring for Barça U19 against Aston Villa U19. Jordi Pesquer with a brilliant ball in. [@ArsenKveFCB] #fcblive 🔥
You can watch Barça U19 vs Aston Villa U19 live on Movistar, TNT Sports 4, Barça's YouTube+ or here for free on this link in the quoted post.
🎥 | 𝐆𝐎𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐋𝐋. Joni Hernandez doubles the lead for Barça U19. Ebrima Tunkara follows up his goal with an assist. #fcblive
37' Aston Villa U19 pull one back from a corner. 1-2. #fcblive #UYL 🟣

Half-time: Barça U19  𝟐-𝟐  Aston Villa U19

From being two goals up to being 2-2 at HT, Barça U19 fall prey to two set-pieces. #fcblive #UYL
45' The second half resumes. #fcblive #UYL
80' Goal Aston Villa U19. They take the lead and come back from 2 goals down. 𝟑-𝟐. #fcblive #UYL 🟣
🎥 | 𝐆𝐎𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐋𝐋. Iu Martinez equalizes for Barça U19 in the added time. Great goal. 3-3. https://t.co/1V5xT6WdjF 💥

Full-time: Barça U19  𝟑-𝟑  Aston Villa U19

Points shared at the Estadi Johan Cruyff. #fcblive #UYL 🔵🔴

GOALLLLLLLLLLL LAMINE YAMALLLLLL. 1-0 BARÇAAAAAAAAAA 🔵🔴🔥
